· MACD 히스토그램 궤적 (-0.1124 → -0.3149) — 악화 중, 약세 수렴 지속

· 스윙 지지선 ($63.90) — 피벗 S1($63.44) 및 20일 저가($64.75) 기반
· 스윙 저항선 ($68.35) — 5일 고가($66.85) 및 볼린저 상단($69.24) 기반
· 5일/20일 고가·저가 패턴 (Higher Low / 횡보) — 5일 저가와 20일 저가가 동일하여 횡보 패턴 확인
[거래량·결론]
· 거래량 비율 (0.33배) — 5일 평균 대비 급격히 위축, 현재 움직임 신뢰도 하락
· 현 구간 진단 (축적구간) — RSI 과매도 진입 및 MACD 약세 수렴, 거래량 위축으로 관망 유지
analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price ($64.83) vs SMA5/20/50 ($65.56/$67.08/$67.01) — below short-term SMA5, below mid-term SMA20/50
· Position vs SMA100/200 ($62.62/$60.11) — approaching long-term support levels
· 52-week position (75.3%) + current price range is in a pullback phase from historical highs
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (50.9 → 40.7) — entering oversold, confirming downward momentum
· MACD histogram trajectory (-0.1124 → -0.3149) — worsening, continuing weak convergence
· Bollinger Band current price position (near lower band $64.92) — approaching lower band, band width contracted to 6.44%
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support ($63.90) — based on Pivot S1 ($63.44) and 20-day low ($64.75)
· Swing resistance ($68.35) — based on 5-day high ($66.85) and Bollinger upper band ($69.24)
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (Higher Low / Sideways) — 5-day low equals 20-day low, confirming a sideways pattern
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.33x) — significantly contracted compared to 5-day average, reducing confidence in current movement
· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation) — RSI entering oversold and MACD weak convergence, with contracted volume, maintaining a wait-and-see approach
